newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Belknap County, N.H..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Belknap County, N.H..

text.p: Belknap County, New Hampshire will receive proposals until 11:00 A.M. (E.D.T.), Tuesday,

for the purpose of the following described Bonds of the County. Bonds will be dated June 15, 1997. The first Principal payment will be June 15, 1998, and annually thereafter. Interest will be due semi-annually on December 15 and June 15, commencing December 15, 1997. Bonds will be issued in fully registered form by means of book-entry system in $5,000 denominations or any integral multiple thereof. Principal and interest will be payable at Citizens Bank New Hampshire, Manchester, NH, Paying Agent.

Bonds offered for delivery, when, as and if issued, subject to final approving opinion of Devine, Millimet & Branch, PA, Manchester, NH. Delivery of the Bonds in definitive form will be made on or about June 30, 1997. Additional information concerning the Belknap County Bonds is contained in the Official Statement dated June 11, 1997. Copies may be obtained from Jan Snyder, Citizens Bank New Hampshire, Financial Advisor, 875 Elm Street, Manchester, NH 03101 (603-634-7167).
